title: review: S1a: canonical skill registry (P1/P2 states, P22 versions by content hash, P32 provenance fields) built from skills/**/SKILL.md, `orchestrator skills` CLI, and the P0 inventory doc
spec:
Program brief .orchestrator/roadmap-skills.md P0, P1, P2, P22, P32 (P37 stage 1). Facts (Planner grep, provenance repo): 12 skills under skills/<role>/<name>/SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter (name, description; some carry scripts/ and references/); 11 are symlinked into .claude/skills so every Claude worker sees their descriptions; Codex executors load implement-spec through AGENTS.md; worker prompts do not name skills; no registry, telemetry or per-skill tests exist except tests/test_memory_skill.py; task classes come from attribution.task_class (security, architectural, debugging, mechanical, unfamiliar, or explicit constraints.task_class); workflow strategies are strategy.STRATEGIES.
Do:
1. orchestrator/skills_registry.py (new). `SkillRecord` dataclass with: id (f"{role}/{name}" from the directory path), version (12-hex sha256 of the SKILL.md body + scripts/ + references/ contents, i.e. a content hash; the same value is content_hash), name, description, provenance ("builtin" for skills/ in this repo; "repository", "learned", "external" reserved), trust ("trusted" | "untrusted"), state (one of STATES = discovered, quarantined, testing, shadow, active, demoted, disabled), roles (from the directory: planner/scout/review/triage/executor; "review" also serves spec_review and challenge; explicit override via an optional frontmatter key `roles:`), task_classes (frontmatter `task_classes:` or ["*"]), triggers (frontmatter `triggers:` list; default: keywords parsed from the description's "Use when ..." / "Use for ..." clause, lower-cased, ≥4 chars), tools (frontmatter `allowed-tools`/`tools:` plus every script under scripts/ as "script:<path>"), context_requirements (frontmatter `requires_context:` or []; P26 placeholder), output_contract (frontmatter `output:` or the text after "Finish with" / "Output" in the body, ≤300 chars), est_tokens_l0 (description chars//4), est_tokens_l1 (trigger+objective+output chars//4 when present), est_tokens_l2 (full body chars//4), security_class (frontmatter `security:` or "internal"), repo_scope ("orchestrator" default; frontmatter `repo:`), validation ({"tests": [test module paths that mention the skill dir], "status": "untested"|"tested"}), promotion_state (mirror of state for the promotion module), created_at/updated_at (git log of the SKILL.md path; fall back to mtime), source (path).
2. Registry store: `.orchestrator/skills/registry.json` (under STATE) with {"version": 1, "synced_at", "skills": {id: record}} plus a per-skill state override file `.orchestrator/skills/state.json` {id: {"state", "trust", "since", "reason", "history": [...]}} so lifecycle transitions are observable and reversible (P2): `transition(id, new_state, reason)` validates against ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS (discovered→quarantined/testing/disabled; quarantined→testing/disabled; testing→shadow/disabled/quarantined; shadow→active/testing/disabled; active→demoted/disabled/shadow; demoted→shadow/testing/disabled; disabled→discovered/testing) and appends to history; `rollback(id)` restores the previous state. Builtin skills start in state "active" and trust "trusted" (explicit, recorded in state.json with reason "builtin baseline 2026-09-22"), never inferred from provenance at runtime: registry.state(id) reads state.json first.
3. `sync(root=STATE, skills_dir=REPO/skills)` rebuilds records from disk, keeps state.json entries, marks skills whose content hash changed as version bumps (history entry "content changed: old→new"; state unchanged for builtins, "testing" for anything not trusted), and marks missing skills "disabled" with reason "source removed".
4. CLI: `orchestrator skills sync|list|show <id>|transition <id> <state> --reason|rollback <id>` (list prints id, state, trust, roles, est tokens l0/l2, version; --json). Exit non-zero on an invalid transition.
5. docs/skill-intelligence/00-audit.md: the P0 inventory table (one row per skill: id, roles, purpose, trigger, tokens l0/l2, tools, output contract, repo specificity, always exposed?, dynamic?, tests, provenance) and the exposure facts above; docs/skill-intelligence/01-registry.md (≤60 lines): the record schema, the state machine, the CLI, revert path (delete .orchestrator/skills/*.json and re-sync; nothing else changes).
Constraints: read-only with respect to skills/ and .claude/skills (no compaction, no symlink changes: that is S2/S5); no behaviour change for any worker. Never quote double-brace placeholder tokens literally.
Tests (unittest, `import _harness` first): tests/test_skills_registry.py::test_sync_builds_twelve_builtin_records_with_content_hashes, ::test_triggers_parsed_from_use_when_clause, ::test_transition_validates_and_records_history, ::test_rollback_restores_previous_state, ::test_state_override_beats_provenance (a builtin marked disabled in state.json reports disabled), ::test_sync_marks_missing_skill_disabled_and_version_bump_on_content_change, ::test_cli_list_and_invalid_transition_exit_code.
Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.
acceptance: docs/skill-intelligence/00-audit.md lists all 12 skills; docs/skill-intelligence/01-registry.md exists; `uv run orchestrator skills sync` then `list` runs; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

result.summary: Verified: all 7 new unittest cases pass, full tests-green gate passes (1117 tests), docs match the 12-skill inventory, CLI sync/list/show/transition/rollback work end-to-end against the real repo, and the cli.py dispatch chain insertion doesn't break other subcommands. Scope is respected (only the 5 allowed files touched, skills/ and .claude/skills untouched). One real but non-blocking correctness bug found in the content-change history bookkeeping for non-builtin skills (see comment) — doesn't affect builtins, doesn't fail any acceptance test, and this stage is read-only/observational with no consumer yet depending on the field, so it doesn't block merge.

comments.issue: On a content-change for a non-trusted skill, sync() demotes state to 'testing' (line 229) but the history event appended just above (line 224) sets to: entry['state'] evaluated before the demotion, so 'to' equals 'from' and the log never shows the state actually became 'testing'. Reproduced directly: after editing a shadow-state, untrusted skill's SKILL.md and re-syncing, current state is 'testing' but history[-1] reads {'from':'shadow','to':'shadow'}. This undermines the P2 goal that lifecycle transitions be observable via history; not caught by tests since the builtin-only test fixtures never hit the non-trusted demotion branch.
